Loan Disbursement / Recovery Officer Job at LEAM Consulting




        
    

        
        LEAM Consulting is the foremost consulting firm which stands out in areas of professional certification training, HR advisory services, Business Development / Startup and IT consulting services in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Loan Disbursement / Recovery Officer 

Job Location: Anfaani Ring Road, Ibadan - Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a loan disbursement / collection Officer to facilitate lending for our clients by assessing creditworthiness and processing relevant paperwork.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Good communication skills and proven work experience as a Credit Officer, Loan Officer or similar role.
	Reviewing loan requests and assessing clients’ financial status.
	Follow up with clients about loan renewals and monitor progress of existing loans requirements and skills.
	Analyze risks and approve or reject loan requests, contact clients to gather financial data and documentation.
	Ensure loan applications adhere to company policies, internal credit policies, and legal/regulatory requirements.


Requirements


	Minimum of NCE.


Benefits


	Salary: N80,000 monthly.
	Free accommodation and calling allowance


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Loan Disbursement officer" as the subject of the mail.

Note: For more enquiries, contact this Whatsapp number: 09022167744.

Personal Banking Sales Executive Job at Careers Verified




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

At Careers Verified, we go beyond narrowly defined client’s issues, we create opportunities for our clients, candidates, colleagues, collaborators, and the community. Through a network of diversified but highly complementary line of business, we help organizations find critical talent, access cutting-edge advice and get the innovative support they require to grow in a challenging market. We partner with businesses and organizations of varying size and structure across diverse sectors, such as Oil and Gas, Engineering, Finance, Telecom, FMCG, Legal, Technology, Healthcare, Travel and Aviation etc. to enhance business performance and to optimize for growth to achieve exceptional results. What sets us apart is the depth of our capabilities, creative problem solving approach and proven track record in our practice area combined with in-depth knowledge of the realities of the industries we serve.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Personal Banking Sales Executive 

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT), Abia, Akwa Ibom, Anambra, Bayelsa, Cross River, Delta, Edo, Ekiti, Enugu, Imo, Kogi, Kwara, Lagos, Ogun, Ondo, Osun, Oyo and Rivers 
Employment Type: Full-time

Description


	The Personal Banking Sales Executive is responsible for acquiring new customers, growing the bank's customer base, promoting personal banking products and services, and achieving assigned sales and revenue targets.
	The role involves proactive customer acquisition through field sales, referrals, direct marketing, networking, and relationship management.


Key Responsibilities


	Acquire new customers and open new personal and retail banking accounts.
	Promote and sell the bank's products and services, including savings accounts, current accounts, loans, cards, digital banking solutions, and other approved financial products.
	Generate quality leads through field visits, referrals, networking, community engagement, and direct marketing.
	Meet and consistently exceed assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
	Identify customer needs and recommend suitable banking products and solutions.
	Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities and potential customer segments.
	Follow up on leads, prospects, and customer requests to drive successful conversions.
	Cross-sell and upsell relevant banking products to existing customers.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales activities, leads, and conversions.
	Ensure all customer acquisition and account-opening activities comply with the bank's policies, KYC requirements, and regulatory standards.
	Work closely with branch teams and other internal stakeholders to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
	Participate in sales campaigns, activation exercises, trade fairs, market activations, and other business development activities.
	Monitor competitor activities and provide relevant market intelligence to management.
	Resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate complex issues when necessary.
	Prepare regular sales and performance reports as required by management.


Requirements


	Minimum of an HND / Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification.
	1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or financial services is an advantage.
	Strong knowledge of sales and customer acquisition techniques.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet demanding sales targets.
	Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
	Good knowledge of the local market and customer segments.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and basic digital tools.
	Must be willing to work in the field and engage prospective customers directly.


Preferred Competencies:


	Sales-driven and target-oriented.
	Excellent persuasion and negotiation skills.
	Strong customer service orientation.
	Good prospecting and lead-generation skills.
	Resilient and proactive.
	Strong time-management and organizational skills.
	Ability to build and maintain professional relationships.
	High level of integrity and professionalism.
	Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision.


Salary
N150,000 /

        At Strivo Labs, we are passionate about helping businesses scale with speed and precision. We specialise in providing end-to-end digital solutions, from custom design and MVP development to automation and content creation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Core Banking Application Engineer 

Job Location: Lagos

About the Role
     

            
    




	We are recruiting a Core Banking Application Engineer on behalf of a financial services client building modern banking infrastructure and digital financial products.
	The engineer will be responsible for developing, extending, and maintaining the organization’s core banking platform, built on Apache Fineract and Mifos, while supporting integrations with payment systems and other financial platforms.
	This role is suited for engineers who enjoy working on banking infrastructure, financial systems, and enterprise-grade applications.


Key Responsibilities
Core Banking Development:


	Develop and implement new features for the core banking platform using Apache Fineract and Mifos.
	Customize platform capabilities to support internal workflows, financial products, and regulatory requirements.
	Extend platform modules supporting lending, accounts, and transaction management.


System Integrations:


	Integrate the core banking platform with internal services and third-party systems, including payment gateways, reporting tools, and operational platforms.
	Design and maintain RESTful APIs to enable secure and reliable integrations.


Platform Maintenance:


	Diagnose and resolve system issues affecting platform performance and stability.
	Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards.
	Monitor and improve system reliability and scalability.


Technical Collaboration:


	Work closely with product managers, engineers, and analysts to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
	Contribute to discussions around system architecture and platform improvements.
	Maintain technical documentation for system architecture and integrations.


Security & Performance:


	Ensure the core banking system meets security and reliability standards.
	Support performance optimization and platform scaling initiatives.


Requirements
Technical Skills:


	Strong proficiency in Java
	Experience with Spring Framework
	Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs
	Strong knowledge of MySQL or PostgreSQL


Platform Experience:


	Hands-on experience with Apache Fineract or Mifos is highly preferred.


Domain Knowledge:


	Understanding of core banking operations and financial systems


Other Skills:


	Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
	Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional engineering teams
	Strong documentation and communication skills.
